messages:
juan: quick proposal — i want to tighten the client-facing error taxonomy so customers see fewer ambiguous 5xx/500 messages and get actionable guidance. thinking: 4 buckets (client, quota, transient infra, terminal model). want console badges + a short retry hint header. advice?
emma: agree on the buckets. can you sketch the header + badge copy? short is key. :+1:
sachin: minor nit — model failures sometimes look like infra. we should propagate a model_subcode in telemetry and the header so clients and console can disambiguate.
juan: draft header idea: `x-rw-error-kind: client|quota|transient|model_terminal` and optional `x-rw-retry-after-ms`. badge copy: small pill on route and request logs: "client error", "quota", "transient", "model". tooltip: 1‑line suggestion (e.g., "Quota: reduce batch size or request higher quota").
maria: telemetry question — we need consistent span tags. propose `error.kind`, `error.subkind`, `route.tier`, `decision.routed_to`. that will let dashboards pivot. also add a boolean `user_visible_hint` when we include a retry hint.
oliver: sounds reasonable. rollout plan? we can't flip headers on by default without SDK changes and docs. maybe staged: 1) telemetry-only (no header in responses) for 2 weeks 2) include header but behind flag 3) enable by default with 2-week warning banner in console.
juan: +1. telemetry-only first. i'll add `error.subkind=model_oos|model_numerics|model_policy` to capture brief categories. can we use sampling to avoid noise?
sachin: sample 10% for free-tier tenants, 100% for enterprise. also capture sequence_length percentile to correlate with model OOMs.
emma: UX: console banner copy needs to say impact and action. suggestion: "New error badges and retry hints arriving — opt-in telemetry available now. Check affected routes in Diagnostics > Errors."
maria: ops note: add an alert when `error.kind=quota` spikes 3x baseline in 5m for any tenant. otherwise product might miss regressions.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/errtax-telemetry -> staging (CI passed). ETA 12m. :rocket:
juan: thanks all. next steps: i'll open a short RFC with the header names, telemetry fields, and rollout windows. will include sample console mockups and an alert rule. please add comments on the RFC (esp. SDK owners).
